atoms.body:
# ABDM-1040, the HIU id is not recognised

## In plain words

ABDM does not recognise the [Health Information User](/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary#hiu) (HIU) id on this request. The message is "Invalid HIU ID". Like the [HIP](/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary#hip) case, this is a registration problem, so retrying does not change it.

## When it goes wrong

Confirm the entity is registered in the HIU role and that `X-HIU-ID` carries the HIU id, not the HIP id. If you hold both ids, keep them in separate configuration values so they cannot be swapped.
atoms.summary: ABDM does not recognise the health information user id on the request, which is a registration problem rather than a request problem.
atoms.title: ABDM-1040, the HIU id is not recognised

reply.Text:
The error means ABDM doesn't recognize the HIU ID you're sending. Since you're registered as both HIP and HIU, the issue is likely **swapped IDs**: you're probably sending your HIP ID in the `X-HIU-ID` header instead of your HIU ID.

**Check:**
1. Verify you have two separate IDs from your registration (one HIP, one HIU)
2. For consent fetch (an HIU operation), confirm you're sending the **HIU ID** in the `X-HIU-ID` header, not the HIP ID
3. Store them in separate config values to prevent mixing them up

The portal's error documentation recommends this exact setup when holding both roles — keep the IDs in separate configuration so they can't be confused during requests.
